title: Membership in a binary affine subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a,x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $x$ belongs to the affine translate of $H$ by $a$ if and only if $x+a\in H$.
